reviews.text: I had been coming to this same vet for 4 years and I used to love it for my dog. It had the sweetest efficient vet techs. This place has absolutely gone downhill over the last year or so hiring terrible staff that do not know how to deal with animals. My super sweet dog was scared of them so they called my dog aggressive. They charged me for a fecal sample and they didn’t take one. They just gave me the container to take it myself. They tried to do that the next year as well and w When I asked him not to charge me for the fecal sample if they weren’t gonna take it, they said they were gonna charge me for it anyway. I tried to go in for flea medicine and they tried to charge me $600 because they needed to do all this other preventative stuff. And rude too

I brought my senior chihuahua in basically as a walk in who has been attacked by another dog leaving him in horrible condition. I came in sobbing and frantic. I CANNOT say enough about the level of care, sensitivity, honesty, and understanding I received from every staff member I encountered. The doctor/techs/staff all spoke to me so calmly and respectfully, I was actually able to calm down myself. I am honestly close to tears again writing this review remembering how special I felt we were treated. I was anticipating a bill in the thousands, so was relieved to receive a bill for a bit less, which I also feel like was a very fair price given his awful condition. This is not my normal vet and I live too far for it to be, but if things were different I would absolutely make it my regular vet. I will NEVER forget the level of care we received here and am eternally grateful for the experience we had.
Everyone is really nice and the vet is knowledgeable. It’s very clear the company tries to do right by their customers/pets. Pricing is fair. Highly recommend this location.

We’ve been bringing our dog to Garden Oaks Veterinary Clinic for years, so we’ve seen the practice evolve and change over time. The team they have in place now feels especially strong, and it really seems like they are building something great. What stands out most is the quality of the people and the genuine care they show both the animals they treat and the people bringing them in.

Brianna, who goes by Bri, has cared for our dog over the past few years, and her compassion has always stood out. He is a nervous dog, but she does whatever she can to make him feel safe and comfortable. During our most recent visit, she held him close, spoke to him sweetly, and even called him “papacito” while helping him relax. It was a small moment, but it perfectly captured the way she treats him with patience and genuine affection.

Bri also takes the time to explain what she is doing, answer our questions, and make sure we understand everything. We never feel rushed or like we are simply the next appointment. That kind of warmth and bedside manner makes a real difference when you are worried about a pet who is part of your family.

We were equally impressed with Dr. Goodnight. She carefully walked us through our concerns, explained everything clearly, answered every question we had, and never seemed in a hurry to move on. She made sure we felt heard, informed, and reassured before we left.

A veterinary practice is ultimately only as good as the people caring for your animals, and we really appreciate the direction Garden Oaks is heading. Brianna, Dr. Goodnight, and the current team are a great reflection of that. We are grateful for the kindness, patience, and care they’ve shown our dog and hope Garden Oaks continues building on that path.

I can’t thank everyone at this veterinary office enough for the incredible care they gave my dog, Charlie, throughout his battle with Cushing’s disease and congestive heart failure. They were always knowledgeable, compassionate, and took the time to explain everything, helping me make the best decisions for his care.

Last Friday, I had to make the heartbreaking decision to say goodbye to Charlie, and the kindness and compassion the entire staff showed meant more than I can express. They made such a difficult day as peaceful and comforting as possible.

I especially want to recognize Bree, the vet tech, who went above and beyond with her empathy and genuine care. Her kindness helped ease one of the hardest moments I’ve ever experienced, and I’ll never forget it.

Thank you to everyone for treating Charlie with such love and dignity throughout his life and during his final moments. I will always be grateful for the exceptional care you provided.

I wholeheartedly recommend this veterinary office to anyone looking for a team that truly cares about both their patients and the families who love them. Their professionalism, compassion, and dedication are exceptional, and I wouldn’t hesitate to trust them with the care of any pet.
Excellent service along with vet and the vet tech were very involved in the care of my pet.  Highly recommend them!
Great experience, super friendly people!

The front desk staff was friendly, and they got me an appointment quickly. At the appointment the staff was friendly to me and to my dog. It was also very efficient with little waiting time. Would recommend
Wonderful and caring service and staff. Timely, thorough and reasonable cost.

We had a great experience at Garden Oaks Veterinary Center! If you need a place to take your pet, call Garden Oaks Veterinary Center. The receptionist was so kind over the phone and in person. The veterinarian and tech that checked on Luna and got her feeling better were awesome! Everyone we encountered was very knowledgeable, kind and great at listening. The office called the next day to check on Luna and I thought that was so nice! They truly care about your pet. Pricing was very fair! We can’t wait to go back under better circumstances for Luna.

UPDATE (for reply):
I 100% had an appointment at your clinic. There's clearly an image of your clinic that is attached to this review as I left your parking lot. It doesn’t take a genius to realize that, obviously, the image was taken from your previous signage. It doesn’t change the fact that it is still your business… but to please you, I have updated the pictures so my review comes back to the top and people can see the business with your new “large white signage”..

To add, your condescending replies don't really help you much in regaining trust or retention. It seems that rather than practice standard customer service for retention, you instead decide to use the "you did not have an appointment at our clinic" as your typical answer to brush off accountability. Aside from that, OBVIOUSLY your clinic is not going to have me listed as "Daveed". That is simply my Google username. I do not need to speak to your director after I already tried speaking to your staff and about my situation and was dismissed without a solution after wasting my time. That's precisely what reviews are for. Especially for those of us Google Local Guides who have a long history of credible reviews and who's reviews weigh heavily on a business. You have over 20 1-star reviews that clearly show the decline of your business overtime and "No, we cannot help you" was the answer I received the day I visited. The handful of 1-star reviews, including mine, prove that.

Next time you reply to a review, try to take a course on client retention and online customer service etiquette. To finish, I didn’t  need to call your director, your director needed to call me. If you chart your interactions with patients correctly, you should have been able to track down the person who you cancelled on that day that first left the review.

ORIGINAL REVIW:
Disappointed disabled veteran with service dog. Ran 15 minutes behind and called at the 10 minute mark. They said no worries to get there as quick as I could. Got there 15 minutes after my scheduled appointment after driving 45 minutes to see them for a quick vaccination visit. When I arrived, the front desk lady told me to head back to the treatment room. As I made my way back, another lady then came out and told me to reschedule instead. Very uncomfortable and confusing to say the least. I explained that I drove very far and offered to stay there all day if need be, so they could see him at any break/cancellation they might have since my dog gets extremely car sick. They didn’t even budge. Why would you tell me I’d still be okay over the phone and tell me to head to the treatment room if you’re going to have someone else change it all up and tell me to reschedule? For a quick vaccination? Just be honest over the phone instead of inconveniencing me when I arrive. My dog has been a patient here since he was 12 weeks old and the quality of service has slowly deteriorated. I’ve had a terrible experience last two times I’ve been here with the staff not being helpful or transparent. Will not be coming back and do not recommend.

We’re always pleased with the care we receive for our cats and dogs. The technicians and veterinarians are knowledgeable and thorough. We appreciate that at Garden Oaks your team can offer in-house second opinions. Your team always goes above and beyond! Highly recommend.

Just relocated here from out of state and found Garden Oaks on the AAHA website. We left our pup’s first visit feeling really happy. From the warm welcome at the front desk to the vet tech and doctor, everyone was friendly and professional. They took the time to answer all of my questions, performed a very thorough exam, and the pricing felt very fair and reasonable. We truly appreciate the great care—thank you all so much!
Always excellent service to my dogs.  It’s a pleasure having them as my vets.

We , the Nair family , enjoyed the whole experience. The entire staff from the greeters to the Vet, were so friendly, compassionate , caring and courteous. We are glad we found you and are looking forward to seeing you on our upcoming visits for our puppy.
My dog is a semi frequent flyer at the vet and we have never had a bad experience here. 10/10 we see Dr Vega if he’s available but everyone is great. Very nice front desk staff!
Very kind to patients and owners.  Great information about findings after visit.
Good  service for cats. Separate waiting area and exam room is very comforting.
Great and friendly service! Could be a little timelier in seeing patients. The prices are a little pricey.

I’ve had a few disappointing experiences with this vet clinic. During one visit, they even missed giving my dog’s heartworm vaccine, which was very concerning. Unfortunately, situations like this have made it feel like the level of care and attention to detail has declined. Overall, the experience has come across as careless at times and hasn’t met the expectations I have for my pet’s care.
Annual checkup and vaccinations appointment...new client! Terrific throughout, from reception to Tech to MD! Facility is super clean and nice! Very happy with knowledge of Vet Tech and MD!

I was curious as to what type of services were offered there for our Fur Babies.
I was given the information, if I never find the need to utilize.
Great Staff , Kind & Understanding ‼️
Woof 🐶 💙
Everyone that works here will treat you and your fur babies like family. Very knowledgeable and friendly!

We couldn’t get into our usual vet and we had an emergency. Garden Oaks Vet made space for us and contacted our other vet and got all the medical history for us. Staff was great. Dr was pragmatic. Katie at the front desk is delightful and so welcoming. We are excited to find our new family vet.
Awesome folks.  Professional and Astro says they are the best.
Everyone one here is extremely nice and helpful. My dog and I both really enjoy coming to Oak Forrest Vet Center. The veterinarian and vet tech were very informative.

Great service, however be aware of pricing and ask up front for how mouth each prescription is going to be. They’re not very transparent and the office is not on the same page as far as policy and procedures when it comes to refunds for unopened items.

Garden Oaks Veterinary Center has restored my faith in getting pet care for my spicy cat.

My fur baby, Leo, a 5 year old cat, was experiencing mouth pain and I knew he needed some help. He weighs nearly 20lbs and strongly opinionated so it is difficult to get him to cooperate at the vet.

Dr. Vega and his staff went above and beyond to get my baby care. They were so helpful and accommodating to get my Leo the vet care he needed. Everyone was so helpful, compassionate, and wanted what was best for my pet's health.

Garden Oaks Vet is amazing and they really helped me care for my spicy fur baby. They have a separate entrance to the building for cats and their cat rooms have a cat tree in it to keep the cat occupied and feel more comfortable.
Recommend. My furbaby loves it here.

They're very friendly but they're extremely busy. The last two visits my dog and I waited in the room for nearly 45 minutes, saw the doctor, waited another 40.

They're also expensive. I used to come here for convenience.  I ended up needing to go to another vet because Garden Oaks exacerbated the issue and turns out I overpaid by a lot. I guess we are paying for the remodel. I will not be returning here again.
The ladies at the front desk are always so warm and welcoming. The vets and staff all care very much about the animals they are serving.

Unfortunately had to put my elderly dog down and this is the place that I choose, if you are in the same situation don’t go anywhere else but here. They are very welcoming and caring hands down one of the best vets I’ve ever been to.
Fantastic service. Friendly staff who explained treatment options and test results for my dog.

We brought our dog in after she twisted a digit on her paw while playing. She was in a lot of pain when we arrived without an appointment. The staff was so calming and friendly. They got us a room and assured us that a vet would be in ASAP. They were very transparent and upfront with what the visit would most likely cost and the timeframe. We did not have to wait long before a vet and assistant came in to see our dog. They were so kind, gentle, and quick with their care. They communicated with us every step of the way as they evaluated and made a game plan. They treated her and we went home and continued with our day and we feel very lucky for that. Their care and communication has earned our trust, but more importantly our dog Penny’s trust (which is hard to earn!) We are switching our routine check up visits to Garden Oaks because of the wonderful experience we had. And if another emergency happens, Garden Oaks will always be our first call.
It was our first visit, and it was great! Everyone was happy to see us, and everyone treated us with care. We will definitely go back.
Everyone was so incredibly kind and wonderful! And made Margaux super comfortable during her first visit! Can’t thank you enough!
Nice staff! Great vet! Good prices. We 💗 Dr.Day and staff! Wonderful pet side manner! 😉

We always have a great experience with Garden Oaks Veterinary. Everyone answering the phone, scheduling appointments, the techs and vets are all so friendly, professional, and knowledgable. The facilities are also beautiful. Thank you!

I can’t recommend this vet enough! The entire team was amazing with my dog Nala. Super friendly, helpful, and great at communicating. They made everything so easy and stress-free. I was so impressed I even referred my friend to take his dog here too. Thank you for taking such good care of our pups! 💖🐾 …
Very nice and helpful.

Putting a beloved pet down is never an easy decision. Even though we are not regular customers at the Garden Oaks Vet Center, they accommodated us with no hassle. It was a beautiful setting and we did not feel rushed. If they take this much care at the end of a pet's life, I have all confidence that they give great care in general.

Amazing place. They took care of my 2 cats with ease. Very friendly, informative, kind, and just loving. Dr Vega was super chill and shared great information with me and the entire staff as well. Happy to make them my boys go to vet.
The girls who work here are very helpful!! Always answer any questions I have
Bri was my vet tech and was so amazing and sweet with my dog, Myka. Myka loved her and felt comfortable with her and got lots of treats :) Dr. Vega is amazing as well.

5 stars isn’t enough for Dr. Boucher and the care she has shown my pets. She truly took her time with us, walked through pros and cons and was honest about options and risks. We feel very grateful knowing our 2 cats and dog are in her capable hands.

Garden Oaks Vet is a fantastic place to bring our babies. They are very caring. I have taken Bo to other Vets but here they care.
Thank you all for what you do.

Love this office and staff. Everyone is warm and welcoming. Easy to set up online appts if needed, or easy phone call. Love that I can order Rx online as well. I definitely found a great place to take my fur baby!

Dr. Bouche and the team at Garden Oaks Veterinary Center are wonderful. She goes out of her way to explain thoroughly and provide the best care. Was a longtime client of another Oak Forest area vet, until they couldn't see our injured dog for two weeks. In hindsight, I'm so glad that happened so that we were able to find Dr. Bouche.

This vet is AMAZING! I have two cats and we definitely enjoy using the "cats only" entrance and waiting area! Makes such a positive difference for us. And everyone here is so caring and helpful, and they truly listen to all my concerns.
Highly recommend!

Do not go here for international pet travel documents. Their pricing is a "secret". They make you pay a deposit and they don't tell you what the price is. This is a deceptive business practice. These documents should cost $300. Do not pay one single penny more and do not pay any deposit to anyone.

Even though I didn’t got my appointment cause they don’t have walk-ins; it’s appointment based only. Staff were super friendly, helpful and very welcoming! They tried to accommodate me and made me feel like home
Very friendly staff that really cared.
Great customer service. Very polite love them. I’m so glad I change veterinary clinic very reasonable price exceptional customer service
Saw our foster kitty and provided quick and good care.
So far so good. We had our first visit with our new pup and felt very welcome and left feeling informed about our visit to the vet. Glad it was a good and positive experience for us.
Staff have always been friendly and helpful. They always make me feel like my dog is loved there.

This clinic is very responsive, and best veterinarian clinic experience I’ve had. I love the little-to-no wait time, reasonable prices, and the quality time the vet spends with my pet. These appointments never feel rushed. 10/10
Although the vets here are fantastic, the rest of the staff leaves much to be desired.

I went to garden oaks veterinary  I  just wanted them to trim and grind my dog toenails but instead they gave her a rabies shot which was fine but they didn't do the nail trim so I will have to come back and pay an additional office visit fee. I don't recommend them!!!!!! Take your pets to a caring facility that has a better pricing. They are too expensive.  I found a much lower price and caring staff in the Woodlands. I came with my dog muzzled you are such a liar. If my dog was trained to kill you would be dead already. Your staff was unprofessional and not caring. If you can't or refused to do the service don't touch the dog by giving it a rabies shot. You said I refused to muzzle. So you felt the dog needed to be muzzled so why get so close to give a rabies shot. You just wanted me to pay another office visit. You didn't care about the dog. Completely unacceptable!!!
Loved our experience. Open, honest, friendly, communicative. We found a new home for our fur kids.
DR. DAY and staff were amazing with my dog and made me feel assured she was in great hands
I love Garden Oaks Veterinary Center!!! Everyone is amazing, friendly and so patient with our kitties. I’m so glad to have found this place. They even have a waiting room especially for cats!!

My dog doesn’t really like people he’s been that way since he was a puppy.  Every single person that worked at this vet clinic my dog didn’t mind and almost kissed one of the vets.  It takes him a long, long time to warm up to people; my friend had to babysit him three times before he warmed up.  maybe it’s his older age, but I do think more than that it’s the staff at this veterinary clinic.  It really warmed my heart to see him so at ease with strangers.
I was scared to take my dog to the vet and had to wait a long time to have a budget for it.  The five items on my invoice were equal to a quote I got from a different veterinarian office just for an exam.
They saw me the same day. I called to make an appointment. I didn’t have to wait too long for them to come give my dog care. They were so sweet and explained to me what I had to do and answered all the questions I had in the way that didn’t make me feel stupid.
The cherry on top of the cake is my dogs two year-old human sister came with us everyone there was so nice to her too. She walked behind the front desk to say hi. The lady didn’t mind at all. I wish I remembered her name.
AnyWho, can’t recommend this place enough  & wish I could give more stars

Dr. Metoyer and her staff did such a great job listening to our concerns about vaccines and coming up with plan on avoiding a bad reaction. They are always so friendly and do their best to make us and our pups feel at ease. We appreciate all that they do!

Dr. Moore and her team cared for our English bully Pippa throughout her life. For almost thirteen years, Oak Forest Vet consistently showed her love and focused care (and with a bulldog, we were there A LOT). Thank you teaching us how to provide the best life we can for our furry family.

Every admin, vet tech, vet that we have dealt with has met us with amazing customer service. Katie in the front is always so welcoming, Dr. Bouche, and Dr. Day have taken exceptional care of my pup on some scary days.

We came from a previous vet who landed us in an emergency ER visit situation, so it’s been a breath of fresh air to not have symptoms brushed under the rug. Dr. Bouche has gone above and beyond with George and we’re so grateful to have made the move to Garden Oaks! This staff really loves your animals and treats them like the family they know they are.
Garden Oaks Veterinary has fantastic services and staff. Dr Day is exceptional!

I appreciate the vets at Garden Oaks Vet Center. They are knowledgeable and make it very clear they want what's best for your pet. They're there to answer any questions with a friendly demeanor. My dog has fear based anxiety and has some trouble at other vets. She is much more at ease at Garden Oaks Vet than she has been with other vets.

Everyone there is exceptional. Katie at the front desk was extremely sweet and nice, offering a hug when I desperately needed it. Dr. Vega has been great with explaining things and walking me through what was happening. The whole staff really went above and beyond to take care of my little angel.
Great staff and Vets.  They strive to make our pets comfortable and take great care of them.  They ask relevant questions to make sure they have all issues covered. Highly recommend this facility.

I am going to make Garden Oaks Veterinary Center my full time clinic now. I went in for a second medical opinion. They listened to my concerns and were open to my opinions that my prior vet did not. Because they listened they were able to identify sickness, figure out treatment, and even caught what could have been a very critical condition for my pet.

They do a lot of their labs in-house and I feel that’s good because of turnaround time. They are a smaller clinic and I believe are “appointment only” with no walk-ins; I think this allows them to be more focused.

We had a great experience here! I was able to get my dog a same-day appointment as a new patient for her swollen ear. The staff was friendly and very patient with my very anxious dog. The facility was also clean. We will definitely be back!
Our elderly dog hates having her feet handled but needed a nail trim. The technicians were skilled, compassionate, and swift in getting the job done.
Really good service
Did a great job and got my Dusty in right away to take care of his eye infection

Garden Oaks Vet is an amazing facility with even more amazing staff. Everyone is so kind and attentive, and I truly feel their concern for me and my fur babies. They’ve supported me when one had to cross the rainbow bridge, and continued that support when I was ready to welcome new fur members to the family. I can’t gush enough how lucky I feel to have found this place and know that my animals are well taken care of.

Amazing care at Garden Oaks Veterinary Clinic with Dr. Bouche

We are beyond grateful for the care and dedication of Dr. Bouche at Garden Oaks Veterinary Clinic. She has been an absolute angel throughout our cat’s illness, procedure, and recovery. Dr. Bouche went above and beyond, even dedicating her weekend off to answer all our questions, guide us through every step, and offer incredible support.

Her professionalism, knowledge, and genuine compassion are unmatched, and we trust her completely with our pet’s health. If you’re looking for a veterinarian who truly cares and provides exceptional service, we wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Bouche and the entire team at Garden Oaks Veterinary Clinic.

100% recommended!
Excellent service. Everyone at Garden Oaks Vet was super nice and made it a great experience for me and my fur baby Contessa. Two thumbs way up for Garden Oaks Vet.

From our first contact with Garden Oaks, it took approximately 5 days from first contact to receiving the Health Certificate for us to take our pet to Indonesia. Remarkable, due to the fact we spent almost 2 months attempting to finalize the documents.
She went into the quarantine clinic in Indonesia on November 14, and arrived at our home on November 15!
We recommend Garden Oaks Veterinary Clinic highly and we thank them for their supreme efforts.
Alex and Elina and Lulu#2, Kushnir

I don't know where to start. My appointment was for 3....I believe we waited about an hour. The lady at the reception desk (too loudly) asked if I had made payment! That was humiliating. I called back with a question and the person said she'd have someone call me back- been since day before yesterday and no call. I felt like I was a side patient. Like they got to me when they could and everyone else was more important. I think I'll just continue with Cypress Fairhaven. It's over an hours drive for me to get to Garden Oaks then to wait for almost ....I'm pretty sure it was an hour - YES! I made it on time - was even early.
We went to GOVC because of the separate cat area. We weren't disappointed.
Wonderful, caring staff.

The ABSOLUTE BEST veterinarian office! The staff and vets are the kindest, most compassionate, patient people who are always there to answer questions about my fur baby. The level of customer service is beyond words! I cannot thank you enough for treating our dog like your own. 🙌🏽 …
Dr. Bouche is wonderful!! She takes the time to answer any questions or concern you may have and very smart. Love her
Amazing place!! Staff wonderful! Thank you for taking care of my fur baby!

I can’t rave enough about the staff here at GOV! From Skyler and Briana and the rest of the vet techs, the front desk staff (Sarah and others) and Dr Day, I always know my pups are in great hands. The renovation here also looks wonderful!! Highly recommend
Exelent  services
